signals.name: schema_fail_rate
signals.condition: schema failures over the last 50 records > 10%

signals.name: required_null_rate
signals.condition: required nulls over the last 50 records > 20% and the previous run < 2%

state_machine: HEALTHY --drift--> DRIFT --repair--> REPAIRING --gate pass--> VERIFIED --> HEALTHY; gate fail --> NEEDS_HUMAN; config defect --> INVALIDATED (closed, no repair)

gate.decided_by: the frozen golden set, never the model

limitation: Repairs are verified against a fixed golden set. A layout the golden set has never seen can still pass and still be wrong — those cases need a human. Sentinel will not log in on your behalf, will not bypass bot protection, and will not collect or resell personal data.
